title: Test-Time Training with Next-Token Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2606.21803v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Next-token prediction is the self-supervised signal that trains language models, and every observed prompt token provides the same signal at test time. We study whether this signal can define the inner-loop objective for test-time training (TTT) in pretrained long-context language models. Many TTT architectures require models to be trained with test-time adaptation in mind, limiting their direct applicability to released LLM checkpoints. While recent in-place TTT methods make fast-weight adaptation possible for pretrained LLMs without redesigning the backbone, they leave a central question unresolved: what should each test-time write store? Existing recipes train the fast weight to match a learned local value proxy but they are not directly tied to the self-supervised next-token prediction signal. translated_title: 基于下一词元预测的测试时训练
translated_abstract: 下一词元预测是训练语言模型的自监督信号，而在测试时，每一个被观察到的提示词元都能提供同样的信号。我们研究这一信号能否为预训练长上下文语言模型中的测试时训练（TTT）定义内循环目标。许多TTT架构要求模型在训练阶段就为测试时适应而设计，这限制了它们对已发布大语言模型（LLM）检查点的直接适用性。尽管近期的原位TTT方法使预训练LLM无需重新设计骨干网络即可进行快速权重适应，但它们留下了一个核心问题尚未解决：每次测试时写入应存储什么？现有方法训练快速权重以匹配一个学习到的局部值代理，但它们并未直接与自监督的下一词元预测信号相关联。我们提出了基于下一词元预测的测试时训练（TTT-NTP），这是一种面向预训练LLM的即插即用式快速权重适应方法，它……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TTT-NTP方法，将下一词元预测作为测试时训练的内循环目标，为预训练大语言模型提供一种即插即用的快速权重适应方案，无需重新训练或修改模型骨干。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TTT-NTP, which uses next-token prediction as the inner-loop objective for test-time training, offering a drop-in fast-weight adaptation method for pretrained LLMs without requiring retraining or backbone redesign.
